name: Chocolate Macaroons (no-bake)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup (120 g) margarine or butter

steps: Place the bottom half of a double boiler on the stove to heat.
Place a large metal mixing bowl on top of the boiler. Melt the margarine/butter in this bowl.
Add the white sugar, and whisk until dissolved.
Whisk in the cocoa, breaking up lumps first.
Remove from heat, take to preparation area.
Using a rubber spatula, thoroughly mix in coconut and oatmeal. There should be no dry sections.
Portion onto pan and let set.

culture.text: A macaroon is a small cake or cookie, originally made from ground almonds, egg whites, and sugar, but now often with coconut or other nuts. They might also include jam, chocolate, or other flavorings.
